newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bank BDNI says Q1 net up at 69.1 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Bank BDNI says Q1 net up at 69.1 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesia's Bank BDNI posted a net profit of 69.1 billion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997, against 39.2 billion rupiah in the same period in 1996, Bisnis Indonesia reported on Tuesday.

The newspaper quoted BDNI president director Sjamsul Nursalim as saying that the bank expected to book net profit of 350 billion rupiah in 1997, sharply higher than its 1996's net profit of 190 billion rupiah.
The bank on Tuesday announced that it had received shareholder approvals to pay a 1996 dividend of 40 rupiah per share.
